text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki got injured during training, 
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry. My carelessness has caused 
you worry.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've been treated, let's get 
back to training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Of course. The pain is gone now, so 
there's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, an injury of this degree is a 
common occurrence in martial arts.
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and take a break.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...With all due respect, I do not believe 
an injury of this degree warrants rest."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to fall behind the others. 
Please, I am counting on you.
choice_data_list:
Carelessness is our greatest enemy. We can 
make up for lost time later.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...The longest way round is the shortest 
way home, and rushing until one ruins 
one's health is a tale often heard in 
martial arts as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If you go so far as to say so, 
Trainer, I shall focus entirely on my 
recovery for now.

Yaeno Muteki looked a bit disappointed as 
she headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your understanding. Now 
then, let us head to the track.

When I had her do a light test run, a look 
of pain crossed Yaeno Muteki's face.
choice_data_list:
I can't let you do any more than this 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will focus on recovery 
for now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming all the way to the 
track, and I apologize for the trouble...

Yaeno Muteki spoke with deep regret and 
returned to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... As long as it's light training, I 
should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I will keep things moderate, 
so there is no need to worry."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm proud of having the strength of will 
to not let a minor injury like this stop 
me.

Even after that, Yaeno Muteki trained 
within a reasonable limit, remaining 
mindful of her injury.
